import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    s0 = np.sqrt(t); s1 = np.sqrt(1 + t)
    base = p[0] + p[1]*P + p[2]*P**2 + p[3]*np.sqrt(P)
    return (base
            + s1*(p[4]*np.sqrt(P) + p[5]*P)
            + s0*(p[6]*P + p[7]*P**2 + p[8]*P*np.log(P)))
